content.text:
Grow, from the skin of the back and flanks, a covering of large overlapping keratin scales in its own colors that replaces the axolotl's smooth skin over the back and flanks: it grows in the skin as the axolotl's own covering there, not as pieces added on top; the smooth skin stops at the covering's edge, and the belly and legs keep the axolotl's own smooth skin; the scales are a pangolin's scale layer grown in the skin: overlapping keratin scales rooted in the skin like a pangolin's, in rows that overlap from head to tail like roof tiles, one continuous layer over the back and flanks. Keep the pose, the head, the legs, the smooth skin everywhere else, the background and everything else the same.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.
